name: Base Gaseous Illumination Renderer
definition: The base renderer used for volume illustration examples, implementing physics-based illumination of gaseous phenomena. It can be replaced by a Phong illumination and linear accumulation renderer.
summary: The Base Gaseous Illumination Renderer simulates translucent media by combining opacity transfer with an atmospheric lighting model, distinguishing itself from surface-based rendering through its specific reliance on gaseous illumination.
